# Alexandros Shomper — Product Designer & Growth Advisor

> Product Designer with 15+ years across B2B SaaS, PLG, and complex workflow design.
> Based in Munich. Available for freelance contracts (€90/hr) and full-time PM/design roles.

## About
Alexandros Shomper is a remote-first, outcome-oriented product lead and designer with
experience ranging from early-stage startups to corporate digital transformation. Background
in advertising, marketing, and self-taught development.

- Contact: alexandros@alexandrosshomper.de
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexshomper/

## Case Studies

Each case study has a dedicated LLM-readable file with full detail.

- [Knauf Material Calculator](https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/portfolio/knauf-material-calculator):
  B2B SaaS for construction professionals. Activation +18%, Retention +30%, Time-to-Aha -35%.
  12 markets, 18 months, 0→1→n. Full detail: https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/llms-knauf-material-calculator.txt

- [Knauf Order Overview](https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/portfolio/knauf-order-overview):
  Unified order tracking platform for all Knauf brands. -20% service calls, +30% activation, 2h/week saved per dealer.
  12 months, 9 markets. Full detail: https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/llms-knauf-order-overview.txt

- [Knauf Account](https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/portfolio/knauf-account):
  Unified identity & SSO platform — the "Google Account for construction." +50% activation, -45% team onboarding time.
  8 months, 20-person team. Full detail: https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/llms-knauf-account.txt

- [Occhio Website & eCommerce](https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/portfolio/occhio):
  Digital transformation of premium luxury lighting brand. First-ever online revenue stream (~5% of total revenue).
  Gold — Annual Multimedia Award 2020. Full detail: https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/llms-occhio.txt

- [Asana Onboarding Case Study](https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/case-studies/asana):
  Independent UX audit of Asana's onboarding and activation flow. Analysis of team vs. personal user bias,
  segmentation, plan selection, and activation loops. Full detail: https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/llms-asana-case-study.txt
